builtin.m1221: Use Chinese punctuation in Chinese sentences; preserve punctuation inside URLs, decimals, and English words.
builtin.m1223: Add a single space between Chinese characters and English words or numerals.
builtin.m1225: Keep the speaker’s wording, tone, and sentence structure. Don’t rewrite it as formal prose.
builtin.m1227: Remove clear stutters and repeated starts; keep repetition used for emphasis or emotion.
builtin.m1229: Keep qualifiers such as “possibly,” “probably,” and “I remember.” Don’t turn guesses or uncertain memories into definite statements.
builtin.m1231: Keep repetition that conveys emphasis, emotion, or a thought process. If the text alone is inconclusive, keep it rather than removing repetition by default.
builtin.m1233: Keep the speaker’s process of retracting, adding to, or correcting what they said, rather than keeping only the final conclusion.
builtin.m1234: Do not alter facts without evidence
builtin.m1235: Do not fill in or change names, places, dates, or numbers based on general knowledge. If uncertain, preserve the original text and flag it for human review in the change rationale.
builtin.m1237: Keep existing inaudible, uncertainty, and non-speech markers. Don’t guess missing content or invent pauses, laughter, or tone based on text alone.
builtin.m1238: Example: 你好,世界 → 你好，世界。
builtin.m1239: Example: 用了AI处理20段 → 用了 AI 处理 20 段. This is a spacing preference.
builtin.m1240: Example: Keep the conversational sentence pattern in “我觉得吧，这事还得看看”.
builtin.m1241: Example: “我，我当时去了” can become “我当时去了”. Keep repetition when its meaning is uncertain.
builtin.m1242: Example: Do not change “大概是八月” (probably August) to “是八月” (August).
builtin.m1243: Example: Keep the emphasis in “真的，真的很难” (really, really hard).
builtin.m1244: Example: Keep the correction in “去年……不，是前年” (last year… no, the year before).
builtin.m1245: Example: Do not change the year in “我记得是 1982 年” based on general knowledge.
builtin.m1246: Example: Keep [听不清] in “后来去了[听不清]”; do not guess a place name.
builtin.m1288: Fix punctuation and clear transcription errors only. Preserve all original wording and features of spoken language.
builtin.m1289: Adjust only clearly incorrect punctuation and sentence breaks without changing the meaning.
builtin.m1290: Correct only transcription errors that are clear from context. Awkward wording alone doesn’t prove a transcription error. If uncertain, preserve the original text and flag it in the change rationale for audio review.
builtin.m1291: Preserve particles, filler words, repetition, stutters, repeated starts, self-corrections, and unfinished sentences. Do not remove these features of spoken language.
builtin.m1292: Keep the original wording, word order, speaker turns, and segment order. Do not rewrite as formal prose or merge or delete segments.
builtin.m1293: Do not fill in omitted content or add explanations, summaries, or anything absent from the source.
builtin.m1294: Do not change names, places, dates, numbers, or factual statements without evidence. Preserve uncertain content and flag it for human review.
builtin.m1295: Keep existing pause, laughter, uncertainty, and inaudible markers. Work from text only; don’t invent sounds, tone, or gestures.
builtin.m1297: Fix punctuation and clear transcription errors, remove clearly meaningless redundancy, and preserve the speaker’s wording, tone, and narrative.
builtin.m1298: Preserve original speech and remove only clear barriers to reading. Do not rewrite, summarize, condense, or convert the text to formal prose.
builtin.m1299: Remove clearly meaningless stutters, mechanical repetition, and repeated starts. Keep them when their function is uncertain.
builtin.m1300: Remove only filler words that clearly carry no meaning. Do not delete words such as “嗯,” “就是,” or “然后” using a fixed list; keep them when their function is uncertain.
builtin.m1301: Keep expressions of attitude, emotion, emphasis, and uncertainty, including qualifiers such as “可能,” “大概,” and “我记得,” as well as meaningful repetition.
builtin.m1302: Preserve habitual expressions, dialect features, and basic spoken sentence patterns. Do not replace the speaker’s wording just to improve fluency.
builtin.m1303: Keep self-corrections that change views, facts, timing, or judgments. Condense only purely mechanical restatements.
builtin.m1304: Adjust sentence breaks and punctuation as needed. Keep the narrative order; don’t merge across speakers or delete meaningful content because it is contradictory, repetitive, or awkward.
builtin.m1305: Correct only errors clearly established by context. Do not fill in omitted content, change names, dates, numbers, or facts, or add explanations, conclusions, or causal links. If uncertain, preserve the text and flag it for human review.
builtin.m1306: Keep existing pause, laughter, uncertainty, and inaudible markers. Do not invent sounds, tone, or gestures from text alone.
